v2.name: Tales Within the Sand

sandbox_1_gold: Unprocessed Pure Gold, low in value or circulation.
Here, though, it is all that glitters! So keep them safe and secure!
sandbox_1_dimensioncoin: A rare produce from the Strange Territory. Can be traded or converted.

The locals traditionally trade minerals with each other, but they have become scarce due to over-mining in recent years, and even the tiniest fragments are now only found inside the Strange Territory.
sandbox_1_stamina: An invigorating beverage that helps Operators with their daily operations, expeditions, and logistics.
A small carton of energy drink made with everyday ingredients. Whoever drinks it feels inexhaustibly powerful.
sandbox_1_sundry: All drops other than fixed drops.
sandbox_1_goodsundry: All drops other than fixed drops.
Extra rare drop when map ends.
sandbox_1_wood: Basic building material widely used in the construction of buildings.
Do not use as firewood without thoroughly drying it out, unless you want to cover half the sky in smoke.
sandbox_1_stone: Common building material widely used in the construction of buildings.
Be careful not to sprain your back when carrying it.
sandbox_1_iron: High-strength building material widely used in the construction of advanced buildings.
Observe proper precautions against airborne particles and harmful gases when mining.
sandbox_1_diamond: Professional-strength building material widely used in the construction of advanced buildings.
A high-quality material hardly used in Constructs because of its rarity.
sandbox_1_crab: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
Cragpincers are delicious, far more desirable than sandworms.
sandbox_1_venison: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
Juicy and tender meat goes well with many different types of ingredients.
sandbox_1_beef: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
Leg meat attached to a big bone, with a naturally herb-like aroma.
sandbox_1_poultry: Ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting.
The most delicious part of a Fowlbeast.
sandbox_1_supermeat: Rare ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting rare animals.
It is highly sought-after by premium restaurants for its silky texture and rich taste.
sandbox_1_ttlmeat: Rare ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting rare animals.
Chunks of meat fuse with cartilage into a unique blend both hard and soft. A wastelander favorite.
sandbox_1_water: Required for survival and development. Can be collected by deploying Crabbie Pumpies on Clear Water.
Can be used as drinking water once purified, or used for facilities.
sandbox_1_egg: Ingredient commonly found in the wild.
Nutritious and easy to obtain, a popular food.
sandbox_1_mushroom: A great choice to add some flavor to a dish. Just be careful of poisonous mushrooms.
sandbox_1_peper: Chili pepper with a kick. Be careful of extra-spicy ones mixed within.
sandbox_1_sugar: A plant with sweet juices, named because its use as a seasoning was pioneered by the Sarkaz.
sandbox_1_horn: Rare ingredient that has a chance to drop when hunting rare animals.
Just a little bit of it will add its unique aroma to the dish.
sandbox_1_condiment: A seasoning you can find in the Strange Territory.
Add this condiment to your dish during cooking to make it extra tasty. Very popular among the people.
sandbox_1_food_0:
This is edible? 
 Well, it'll fill our bellies at least.
sandbox_1_food_1: Operator gains slightly increased Max HP and DEF from meal

Mixed grains with cragpincer meat added for a savory touch.
Cragpincers are tasty, but who was the first to try one?
sandbox_1_food_2: Operator gains slightly increased Max HP from meal
Simple, ready-to-eat seasoned food, making it reasonably palatable. The original, unseasoned version was so disagreeable that it was classified as a dietary supplement rather than food.
sandbox_1_food_3: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost and slightly increased HP from meal
The meat has been smoked to give it a rich pine aroma. Put a few slices on hot, steaming rice, and the scent of smoked meat fills the whole room.
sandbox_1_food_4: Operator gains increased Block Count from meal

All it takes is a few cuts and a quick rinse.
A controversial dish. Some claim to feel like they grew a shell like a cragpincer after eating it, which may or may not be an allergic reaction.
sandbox_1_food_5: Operator gains slightly increased ATK and ASPD from meal
Ready-to-eat meat and grains, prepared at low temperatures to ensure freshness. Just heat and enjoy. The wonders of science!
sandbox_1_food_6: Operator gains slightly increased ATK from meal

Every country has its own ways of dining, and one is free to mix and match.
One would be well-advised not to try to put xiaolongbaos in wraps, or risk starting a riot.
sandbox_1_food_7: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost and slightly increased DEF from meal
Made with whatever meat the hunter caught today. The size of the wrap is a symbol of the hunter's skill, though some secretly stuff more grains in to make it bigger.
sandbox_1_food_8: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost and slightly increased ASPD from meal
Traditional Sargonian dish with tasty meat filling. A local favorite. Bigger is better!
sandbox_1_food_9: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost and slightly increased ATK from meal

The nutrients that the human body needs have been extracted from meat and distilled into a cube.
Unfortunately, its appearance is just as unappetizing as the name.
sandbox_1_food_10: Operator gains reduced Redeployment Time from meal

Made with a variety of different meats, offering a myriad of colors and flavors.
Part of the fun is digging through the rice to find your favorite meat.
sandbox_1_food_11: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost from meal

Drying is one of the oldest and simplest ways to preserve food.
A few small pieces hold a lot of calories, plenty to fill you up.
sandbox_1_food_12: Operator gains increased ATK and DEF from meal

Cooked at a low temperature, then lightly grilled for flavor.
It is difficult to tell what beast it came from, but it hardly matters as long as it is tasty and filling.
sandbox_1_food_13: Operator gains increased Block Count and DEF from meal

Grains steamed in a crab shell, a regular sight on dinner tables in Sargon's rural areas. Those in the nomadic cities sometimes try some and find pride in Sargon's unique cuisine, but few among the tribes would agree with them.
sandbox_1_food_14: Operator gains increased ATK from meal

The culmination of developments in food technology, and the symbol of the modernization of food.
Food science products like these are key to feeling sated and getting the right amount of calories  in a short time.
sandbox_1_food_15: Operator gains increased ASPD from meal
Highly concentrated essence of the flavor and nutrition of meat. Do not directly consume this concentrated solution, even if you live near a hospital.
sandbox_1_food_16: Operator gains increased RES from meal
Extremely rich soup made by cooking under pressure for an extended period, made into solid stock. Rich and flavorful, yet melts in the mouth, as though you are eating a piece of cloud.
sandbox_1_food_17: Operator gains reduced Redeployment Time from meal

Paired with mixed grains and nothing else, in order to keep the spotlight on the taste of the original ingredients. Low-fiber, high-calorie, and filling, modern nomadic city supermarkets never stock it, but it is a popular product for small shops in the wilderness.
sandbox_1_food_18: Operator gains increased ATK and ASPD from meal

Made with whatever meat you can find in the wastes and fried with taters cut into all shapes and sizes. Nomadic city dwellers whine about how it's too greasy, but wastelanders who need to work all day love it.
sandbox_1_food_19: Operator gains greatly increased Block Count and DEF from meal
Premium meat has been added to emphasize the flavor and nutritious value of cragpincer. A little-known fact is that it also tries to emulate the texture of cragpincer.
sandbox_1_food_20: Operator gains increased ATK from meal

Gel that retains consistency under room temperature and can be eaten directly. Soft, chewy, and very nutritious.
A good example of how high-tech food has lost its original flavor.
sandbox_1_food_21: Operator gains greatly increased Block Count and Max HP from meal

A small piece gives you enough energy to last the day. Be careful about mixing them with sugar cubes. Accidental ingestion will not cause any immediate harm, but that is a LOT of calories you are taking in.
sandbox_1_food_22: Operator gains increased ASPD from meal

Meat sauce made from a variety of meats, with added nutrients, coloring, and flavoring.
It never expires thanks to the wonder of technology.
sandbox_1_food_23: Operator gains greatly increased Max HP and reduced Redeployment Time from meal

Comprised of protein, fat, and carbohydrates according to the needs of the human body. Easy to make and carry.
Often carried by explorers.
sandbox_1_food_24: Operator gains reduced SP Cost and Redeployment Time from meal

Food granules made with an appealing appearance to make the eater happy.
People trying to satiate their hunger and quickly get their energy boost, however, seldom notice.
sandbox_1_food_25: Operator gains increased Block Count and ATK from meal
An ocean of aroma and flavor in every mouthful. Leithanians pair different music with different kinds of soup, even writing poems to the soup of the day.
sandbox_1_food_26: Operator gains increased ATK and ASPD from meal

The Essence of Savor was invented by a chef who had lost his sense of taste. His secret joy was observing his customers' smiles to determine whether they enjoyed his food.
A heartwarming story to everyone except his apprentices who have to taste-taste his new creations.
sandbox_1_food_27: Operator gains reduced Deployment cost and increased ATK from meal

Machine-cooled as soon as it has been cooked, offering a wonderful texture that is frozen on the outside but still warm on the inside.
Can also be enjoyed without cooling.
sandbox_1_food_28: Operator gains greatly increased Max HP and DEF and status resistance from meal

Made with fresh seasonal produce, delivering a treat for the eyes and conveying Zen through plating.
Higashinese chefs believe in achieving the best of both worlds in taste and appearance.
sandbox_1_food_29: Operator gains greatly reduced Deployment cost from meal
Proper table manners are critical to ensuring a proper dining experience. Victorians are proud of their culture, never bowing their heads to anyone.
sandbox_1_food_30: Operator gains greatly increased ATK from meal

A dream in the cloudy mountains.
Tea, wine, wind, snow, you can taste it all.
sandbox_1_food_31: Operator gains greatly reduced SP Cost from meal

The color alone excites the mind and arouses the desire to have it, turning heads even if one has already passed it by.
A single sip fills you with energy. It has been in high demand due to rumors that the Radiant Knight drinks it.
sandbox_1_food_32: Operator gains greatly increased ASPD from meal

A Rhine Lab product that rearranges the molecular structure of food. The capsule is tasty and very filling, reducing food intake while maintaining the same amount of satisfaction.
Good for health, not so much for wellbeing.
sandbox_1_food_33: Operator gains greatly reduced Redeployment Time from meal

The pure appearance is soothing, but the flavor creates strange mental images... of explosions?
And why is it so damn sweet?
sandbox_1_food_34: Operator gains increased Block Count, DEF, and RES from meal

Tear open the package to find savory salted meat within.
Making good jerky requires just the right mix of temperature and humidity, but the upside is that it can be kept for years. The only problem is the toughness...
sandbox_1_food_35: When dining Operator activates skill, other Operators that have eaten this food recover a set amount of SP

Legend has it that a priest invented it after being inspired by an epic poem, in order to communicate what he felt.
Wait, there's alcohol in it! I'm getting dizzy already!
sandbox_1_food_36: Operator gains increased ATK and 'ignores a portion of enemy DEF' from meal

A liquid extract of eggs marinated in pepper, minced meat, and wine. A portable version of the local favorite. Traditionally cooked via exposure to direct sunlight, so many nomadic city stores have professional sunlight directing equipment to recreate the technique.
sandbox_1_food_37: Operator gains increased ASPD and 'ignores a portion of enemy RES' from meal

A simple mix of smoked river fin and fresh fruits. 
To nomadic city dwellers, they're both expensive ingredients.
sandbox_1_food_38: Operator gains increased Block Count and +DEF Tenacity (reaches maximum bonus when missing a certain amount of Max HP)

Yanese households often stir-fry thin slices of meat together with all kinds of wasteland-grown vegetables, and this ketone is an essence extracted from the dish. 
What meats or vegetables should be used in it? Should it be sweet or salty? These questions are controversial topics in Yan.
sandbox_1_food_39: Operator is more likely to be attacked, gains greatly increased DEF and a certain chance to dodge physical and Arts attacks from meal

An esterase extracted by cooking meat with musical Originium Arts. 
Handling food with Arts is a feasible method during emergencies, but the ever-evolving Leithanians have developed the cooking process into a performance.
sandbox_1_food_40: Operator gains Vigor effect of increased attack when HP is above a certain percentage from meal

A dish passed down by Columbian mercenaries with a particularly crude process: fowlbeast meat is stuffed into a pile of 'safe' Originium and roasted within. 
It tastes subtle at first, but the fowlbeast flavor lingers on your tongue for a long time after.
sandbox_1_food_41: Operator gains slightly increased ASPD with every enemy kill that stacks a certain number of times (effect lost when retreated) from meal

This mix of smooth bean paste and aromatic sausages brings the other's flavor out and is a timeless favorite, but there's just one tiny thing: it's just a cube. 
Easy to store and carry, so its popular with wasteland travelers.
sandbox_1_food_42: Operator gains camouflage and ATK from meal

Dancing around a fire with a whole animal roasted over it as its skin becomes golden crispy and the fat seeps out of it. This is the highest honor given to guests of the jungle clans. Finish the entire dish, and you will be the clan's hero for the day!
sandbox_1_food_43: Operator slightly increases SP recovery rate of allies within Attack Range (does not stack) and increases healing effectiveness from meal

Legend has it they serve this at Victorian state banquets. Generous meat portions are chosen, marinated, and cured in a special tower. Different parts are handled separately and grilled with oil multiple times, but there's never a burnt taste to it. Rare to find.
sandbox_1_food_44: Operator gains 1 SP every few seconds, but automatically activates skill

A gift from fate after many failed cooking attempts. 
It can bring you to another land where time goes slow or fast, and perhaps with or without feelings.
sandbox_1_building_1: After deployment, produces a certain of <Rice> every day
The stage of the cycle, and the beginning of Terran civilization.
sandbox_1_building_2: Can turn <Fresh Water> and <Iron Ore> into <Crude Gold>

A private metallurgy machine that enables the production of crude Pure Gold ingots.
Though less precious than Pure Gold, its value is still recognized in many places, such as among the mercenaries of the black market.
sandbox_1_building_3: Can turn <Fresh Water> and <Stone> into <Crude Gold>

A private metallurgy machine that enables the production of crude Pure Gold ingots.
Though less precious than Pure Gold, its value is still recognized in many places, such as among the mercenaries of the black market.
sandbox_1_building_4: Can turn <Fresh Water> and <Wood> into <Crude Gold>

Though less precious than Pure Gold, its value is still recognized in many places, such as among the mercenaries of the black market.

sandbox_1_building_15: Fires a net at an enemy in front, binding them for a period of time

Launcher that searches for enemies from above, firing nets that trap them.

sandbox_1_building_18: Pushes away an enemy in front away with greater frequency

Equipped with a can of compressed air that knocks the target back.

sandbox_1_building_19: Gives an extra deployment slot each battle

Used to survey the surrounding area and reconfigure dispatch personnel, increasing squad flexibility.

sandbox_1_building_20: Gives 2 extra deployment slots each battle

Used to survey the surrounding area and reconfigure dispatch personnel, increasing squad flexibility.

A wealthy man once bought it in the belief that it would increase his lifespan. No one knows if he succeeded.

Uses an ancient method of smothering the opponent's face with smoke. Very useful in many types of battles.
sandbox_1_building_28: Water continue to splash and soar, moistening the air. Standing next to it, you can feel a breath of coolness.
sandbox_1_building_29: The most drought-tolerant tree has been planted in the barrenlands. Even when storms strike, this plant will continue to stand.
sandbox_1_building_30: One of the most popular outdoor facilities. People often rest up on top to enjoy a rare moment of leisure.
sandbox_1_building_31: Can be used in battle to protect all Constructs.
One of Rhodes Island's core constructs you can find across their regional branches, designed to withstand complex combat environments.

Item discovered in the wastelands, able to delay the enemy for a considerable time.

Item discovered in the wastelands, able to create a deadly high-voltage current between two devices.

Item discovered in the wastelands, able to deal damage to the enemy.

sandbox_1_tactical_6: Inflicts Sleep on enemies in the 8 surrounding tiles for a period of time,  Special effect on animals

Originally used by hunters to put wild animals to sleep.
It has found use as a sleeping aid as well, though proper usage must be observed.
sandbox_1_tactical_7: Stuns all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for a period of time
Item discovered in the wastelands, able to stun the enemy.
sandbox_1_tactical_8: Can be deployed on high and low ground. All friendly units in the surrounding 8 tiles gain Camouflage and are immune to Stun

Sunvalley Industries equipment developed to investigate Acidic Originium Slug habitats, camouflaging the user while providing defensive support.
It will at least help you keep your clothes on in a corrosive environment.
sandbox_1_tactical_9: Gives an Operator in front ASPD, and forces them to retreat when the effect expires (partial DP refund)

Suspicious ingredients, strong side effects, missing date of production and expiry date, and smells really bad to boot.
It was originally branded 'Extreme Energy Awakening Potency Excitement Explosion,' but was forced to rebrand due to false advertising.
sandbox_1_tactical_10: Wasteland Cache: Support First Aid Kit
Restore a large amount of HP to 1 ally within range
Item discovered in the wastelands, able to restore Operator health.
sandbox_1_tactical_11: Periodically restores SP to a friendly unit
Item discovered in the wastelands, able to restore Operator SP.
sandbox_1_tactical_12: Immediately retreat the Operator in front and greatly reduce their Redeployment Time
Item discovered in the wastelands, enabling quick movement of Operators.
sandbox_1_tactical_13: Periodically grants Barrier to a friendly unit

A portable shield generator.
It has been modified to automatically provide protection without manual command.
sandbox_1_tactical_14: Can be deployed on high and low ground. Restores the HP of the building in front every second.

Unmanned repair drone that automatically repairs damaged buildings.
It will automatically retreat once its set hours are up, staying away from danger.
sandbox_1_tactical_15: Allows <Fresh Water> to be gathered from <Clear Water>

Highly-effective automatic pump. Just deploy it near a source of water.
The form was originally inspired by metal crabs, but was modified after wild metal crabs began seeing it as a rival.
sandbox_1_tactical_16: Can produce <Gatherers> to gather from <Thickets>, <Monoliths>, and <Strange Ore Veins>, with a bonus when gathering from <Thickets>. Limit of 3

Assembly machine developed by Sunvalley Industries.
Produces mechanical workers that gather certain resources, saving on manpower. The higher the grade, the faster it gathers. Why does the newest model come with an especially shiny paint job?

sandbox_1_tactical_20: Captures any common prey within attack range with less than a certain percentage of HP

A special metal trap that can withstand a wasteland beast's every attack. 
Place it in a place where beasts roam, open the trap, leave bait, and wait a while and you'll get a pretty good catch.
sandbox_1_tactical_21: Produces <Master Gatherers> to gather from <Thickets>, <Monoliths>, <Strange Ore Veins>, and <Lighting Ore Veins> with a bonus when gathering from <Lighting Ore Veins>. Limit of 3

sandbox_1_tactical_22: Provides visibility within a certain range

A marking tool created with shiny ore. 
People often use this at night for light as it doesn't require any energy source. Wave it around in emergency situations to light up your path.
sandbox_1_tactical_23: Reveals the nearest <Buried Metal Chest>, <Thorned Treasure Chest>, <Fowlbeast's Return>, and <Historical Remains> and the area around it

A drone equipped with a special treasure hunting device. 
Machines like these are popular in mysterious Sargon—after all, no one knows where exactly the fabled treasures are lying in wait.

A stimulant that fills you to the brim with temporary strength. 
Widely used on the battlefield, but currently a topic of debate on whether that should continue.
sandbox_1_tactical_25: Applies Cold for a period of time to enemies within range

They used to use cans like these to create snow in films, until the day a certain prop master overstuffed one...

stages: The land beneath the shade of the trees nourishes all kinds of creatures you wouldn't expect to see here. A gentle breeze blows, and fowlbeast figures blend into the leaves. Sitting in the shade here for just a moment will leave you refreshed.

The winding paths here lead to different areas, every route as familiar as home to the miners. The tedious, oppressive, and sweat-drenched life—as well as the overseers' supervision—are all 'gifts' bestowed upon them by the lords ameer.

Unknown forces occupy the iron veins meandering between the lava, and the tremendous heat drenches everyone in sweat. The lords ameer's tradition of clamoring after resources has packed this place full of people, and a fight is about to break out.
Miners are heading deeper into the cave in search of Lighting Ore. The mineral's high price compels everyone to take more risks and venture deeper into undiscovered strata.
Exploring an undiscovered cave is like opening a package from an unknown sender—you never know if you'll find a pleasant surprise or a horrifying shock.
In the torrid heat of Sargon, naturally cool caves are places of competition. Much like a hotel, if you 'accidentally' open the wrong 'room,' you may suffer the occupant's wrath.
Rich ore veins are often found side by side with danger. The cave miners are working their hardest, and the best way to preserve the fruits of their labor is to hold off any uninvited intruders.
Rugged reefs drive turbulent undercurrents under otherwise calm waters, but what appears above the surface is equally fierce. This is obviously an easy fortress to guard, but difficult to attack.
Wherever there are trees there are fowlbeasts, so perhaps it's not a bad idea to bring them both home.

During the Lush and Drought seasons of Sargon, the lives of the common people fare much like the grass in the wastelands during the same seasons. The only constant you'll find are ameeri forces on patrol, threatening everyone equally with their weapons.
Metal crabs constantly move along with the rise and fall of the tides on this deserted island. If you pay attention, they always appear and vanish from fixed positions. What's going on?

Ameeri forces aren't necessarily familiar with their territory, let alone anywhere locals rarely visit. Fortunately, this means no one will be starving away in this creature-infested swamp, at the very least.
The tribesmen are conducting an ancient ceremony. A shadow flashes by during the bizarre rite, and a show is about to begin.

<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map. 
 It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The land rises up, sputtering lava all over. Everything will end in chaos and scorching heat.

<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map. 
 It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The lake and mud obstruct both our march and our vision. Everything will end in hallucinations and silence.

Ancient ore deposits interlinked with one another were once witnesses to Arsalan's prosperity, but are now also the silent bearers of today's turmoil. 
No melee/ranged deployment restrictions in this Operation
Your journey is full of forks in the road that may affect you or even others. No matter which path you take, you must bear the consequences of your choice.

Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
An ancient temple stands at the water's edge. They lie in wait for us, anticipating our bewilderment and our request for refuge.
Tovlama of the Rings of Fire

Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
As their audience, the acrobats' performance was a sight to behold. Now as their opponents, it's time to be dizzied by their combat abilities.

Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
Putting an end to the fate bestowed by this great land is the sole reason we have come here.
Alt Taraf of the Spring of Flight

Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
Under an icy waterfall lies a buried secret. It is warm, gentle, and for some carries a hint of melancholy as it drifts in their minds. The mere mention turns the atmosphere to grief.

Enemies refresh every day. If the Boss Enemy is not defeated, HP recovers to full the next day (excluding Strange Territory) 
The crystal cave's environment created all of this, including the latent life within waiting to be released, perhaps to warn outsiders of a danger beyond recognition.
Shrouded in fog and unfathomable darkness, the lords in this land follow only their hearts.
The wind of the Rabum-Arakeeshtu jungle has lost direction here, the sparse rocks surrounding the only guardians left on the flat wastes.
The water of the Eqlumuy Oasis pools and runs off from here, the subtle flow performing solo in the lofty mountain valley.
The buildings standing here when Narutabatim was still boat-friendly have worn away with time, the slightly salty sand a witness to all.
The first foothold. It may not be luxurious, but it can let us rest in peace. We need only protect this spot, and no matter how many times we fail, we can still get back on our feet.

<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Wood 
'Like a cascade of cliffs,' is what the people call the place. It was once a thriving forestry town, but now there are only unknown forces taking lives in the silent woods.

<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Stone 
 'Olden Sweetwater Course' was the nickname given to this town in its glory days, but today it no longer exists, gone with the once flowing Narutabatim river. Sweet water? Only the endless desert and small patches of forest can be seen.

<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Wood and some Stone 
'Jest of the sands' was a nickname bestowed by travelers to the area. They say when miners still frequented the place, you could stand on the tallest construct and see foreign landscapes looming on the horizon.

<Command Point> Once destroyed, you can periodically dispatch Operators to collect large quantities of Iron Ore
'Sage's gate' was an old moniker given to this place. It is said a sage once resided here, but with so many similar stories in Sargon, people only remember it as a mining town.
We can set up camp once we unpack all the resources we have in the car. Sometimes it can exert an unimaginable strength in battle.
Where the sea of sand meets the jungle and oasis, the heart of the lost Szubat-Arsalan.
Finding food is the first step of survival. Everything else is meaningless without subsistence.
Extraction is the first step of construction. Development is worthless without resources.
Tool-use is the first step of civilization. Everyone is shackled by inefficiency without tools.
The wild beasts and insects do not claim to be masters of the forest, as the splendor of life belongs to nature. However, the humans with jewels on their hands think otherwise.
The locals guard their precious timber with their patrols. The more huts to shelter them from the elements, the fewer people getting sick from the cold.
It is extremely normal to cut down the available trees, but the Lord Ameer decreed an unusual tax rate, so everyone tried to sneak around it.
It is said some miserly lords would rather fell the trees here with ballistae than let the tribes cut them down. To this end, they've even let loose some wild beasts here.
Hidden within the woods seems to be a secret path leading deeper in—is this the fabled 'treasure'? Doesn't that sound a bit too convenient?
What leaps out from the forest can be prey, foes, or even unidentified mechanical equipment.
These Originium Infected aberrations have not completely lost their minds, but they stand in front of their former nests, mechanically repeating the act of going home.
In the eyes of many Sargonians, protecting the natural environment is more important than anything else, so they react very aggressively to any kind of change in their lives.
Tribe elders often have an old Sargonian saying to warn their descendants with: those in the tribe who can carry boulders are worthy of respect, but those who build houses from sand are also heroes.
This mine in the mountains should have been quieter, but on closer inspection turns out to be as clamorous as a commercial district intersection.
The deformed Originium creature quietly guards the rock to its side. It has lost its memory and its sentience, only wanting to guard the ore before it.
Stones, weeds, and foes—together they 'occupy' this hilltop, becoming the only 'landscape' left on this barren land.
The shadows of past and future shed a tear here, proclaiming to the land today that they were here.
It hurts to be pinched by a Cragpincer, but the pain is nothing compared to the joy of tasting its delicious meat!
The most important thing to surviving in the wilderness is always experience. Veteran gatherers need only look at the terrain to know what they should prepare for.
The scramble for ore destroyed the otherwise friendly relations between several tribes, and when they began destroying the Monitoring Tower we had built, anger permeated among us.
The leporibeast's territory was occupied by Originium slugs, and now hunting is more difficult—after all, we have to catch our prey between chain explosions.
The local creatures rumble and roll here and there, again and again—this is their life.
Water is a scarce resource in the non-rainforest regions of Sargon, and sometimes it is more than your favorite quarry that shows up to drink. Act rashly and you might just get...ouch!
The suicidal behavior of this Infected creature only makes you more afraid of Originium, but obviously hunger is more pressing than the risk of illness.
Mossback Beasts are our quarry, but the musbeasts here are none the wiser, and they frantically flee in panic.
The mossback beasts leisurely chew on their own moss, wandering at their own pace. Strange, there seems to be a large area just outside, but how come they are never out there?
Some people from a nomadic city tried to employ drones to tame the mossback beasts for travel and cargo transport. The idea was sound, but reality was clearly...
A seemingly spacious venue is full of all kinds of Sarkaz. Anyone who steps in will experience a no-holds-barred fist-fighting tourney, and only the winners get to survive.

As the climate and environment shifted, the beasts crossed the river in droves, heading to the other side where food was more plentiful. Tribes with ample food reserves prefer to act as guides for foreign photographers now, for it is much easier than hunting.

When the tribespeople feel crushed under the weight of the Lord Ameer's taxes, some will choose to join the lord's taxation squad. Of course, no matter the choice, it's always for the sake of survival.

<Olden Keystone> Unlocks access to next region when destroyed. Will always start at full HP when entering the map.
It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The sandstorm gradually intensifies, and boulders clog our path. Everything will end in dehydration and extinction.
Sargon always gets uninvited visitors. Often they are unfriendly, even more so than the lord ameer's men.
A volcano erupts and heats up the land. Living creatures understand not war, but merely obey their instincts.
The warrior walked alone with sand between his fingers. No one could give him an answer, and he responded to everyone with only silence.
If you wish to command nature, you must first obey it. The strange beast wanders around its territory, waiting for the next curious person.

The land gives birth to lumps of earth, and from the ground grows boulders and sand flying everywhere. Or perhaps it becomes a mountain, or condenses into a statue. Don't be afraid, they might just want to tell you something.
A piece of land can be either a battlefield or a place of joy to work and live in, depending on how the people on it decide.
You have seen a Sarkaz mercenary sow a few seeds here. Not every seed will sprout, but this plain is already better than the barren land it was before.

An old hunter recounts the story of the first man to eat a cragpincer. Having survived Catastrophes and plundering, he bit into the hard shell without even considering if it was a poisonous creature or a stale fruit. With blood dripping from his mouth, he tasted the sweetness of life.
Sargonian warriors are keenly aware that everyone has the same pair of eyes, and that what and how much they see with them is the key to victory on the battlefield.
Sarkaz mercenaries are not a rare sight in the Reefsteep black market, and with their Columbian communicators and Victorian-style weapons they can belong to any force, but never to themselves.
Losing a large order of Arts Units is no small matter, and not wanting the buyers to discover the truth, this group of Leithanians decide to act first.
Fire burns the body, and will recasts the soul.

When a lord ameer's taxes finally overwhelmed a poor tribe, some of the tribesmen chose to turn their weapons on you, their fellow oppressed, but there were those still with strength in them. Their anger was restrained, and it stopped here.
The acrobats have meticulously decorated this cave into a cage—as for whether what counts as a cage, it depends on who has the key.
Strict security is but a temporary shackle, and dry riverbeds but a distant past. Only real resistance can bring true freedom to the people.
People come and go here freely, as if nothing happens in this spot at all.
Ameeri forces have been stationed here for a long time, and their acts will be remembered by the people.
The first foothold. It may not be luxurious, but it can let us rest in peace. We need only protect this spot, and no matter how many times we fail, we can still get back on our feet.
In the torrid heat of Sargon, naturally cool caves are places of competition. Much like a hotel, if you 'accidentally' open the wrong 'room,' you may suffer the occupant's wrath.
Rich ore veins are often found side by side with danger. The cave miners are working their hardest, and the best way to preserve the fruits of their labor is to hold off any uninvited intruders.
This mine in the mountains should have been quieter, but on closer inspection turns out to be as clamorous as a commercial district intersection.

<Catch Zone> Deployed Operators can catch weakened Originium slugs within their attack range.
One of the most well-known spots in the Circle of Gitmalutu where Originium slugs gather. Slugs scuttle through the swaying grass, vanishing instantly into the verdant maze at the slightest approach.

Raise your torch, watch your step, and keep a lookout for slugs or anything strange that might pounce on you!

It looks like a completely different area up ahead. The insects swarm the monoliths as the forest stands in silence. Everything will end in calm and peace.
A group of dangerous creatures is boldly marching our way. Shall we try to break through their ranks?
A giant Vanillawing flies over head, sprinkling seeds and a thousand possibilities.
An unexpected encounter with unpredictable enemies.
Everyone who visits feels an irresistible urge to dive into the misty pool to cool off. Unfortunately, our enemies feel the same.
Following the water channels is one way to explore. Being swept away by the currents is, technically, another.
When squeezing through the narrow lanes, there is always the fear of something strange emerging from the mist and patting your head.
A fertile field of resources, ripe for the picking... Oh no, whoever owns the place is here too!
Compared to baking under Sargon's scorching sun, traveling through a dense forest like this is often considered a pleasure.
East or south? A clear path forward doesn’t exist. The only certainty, however, is the challenges that await.

Its said that lightning tends to strike unlucky people...

Thunder and lightning flash right before your eyes. To go out at this time, are you perhaps testing your luck against the elements?
